opening: to walk among the fallen gods.
The pantheon was appointed to keep the world in order.
A villain corrupted them, and still they do not know.
They keep their duties. Their servants keep their posts.
You were sent not to destroy them, but to set them free.
pre_boss: Beyond this path, a fallen power
still carries out its sacred duty.
but not the will to obey it.
and release what Heaven once appointed.
victory: The old duty is no longer twisted.
They were never meant to be destroyed.
Only freed from what had bound them.
defeat: The fallen still believe they serve.
